description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates an automation flow as `draft`; does not publish it. Without a graph an empty draft is created to finish in the dashboard editor. The graph format matches `graph` in get_journey output (nodes + edges; the entry node is a segment or an event).

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

settings.description: Entry/exit rules, goal, quiet hours (get_journey `settings` format).

name: create_journey_draft
title: Create journey draft
